title: trifolium procumbens var. pseudoprocumbens
intro: Trifolium procumbens var. pseudoprocumbens, commonly known as a subspecies of the creeping clover plant, is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, supporting the immune system and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium procumbens var. pseudoprocumbens are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
